originalTitle: Ethiopia acquires Russian fighter jets and air defence systems amid war in Tigray
title: Ethiopia's New Sky Protectors!
content:
Hello, super young reporters! Are you ready for some exciting news from our amazing continent, Africa? We are going to learn about a wonderful country called Ethiopia! It's a place full of history and lovely people.

About Our Home, Ethiopia!

Ethiopia is a big country in Africa. It has beautiful mountains and ancient stories. Many friendly people live there. It's known for its delicious coffee and unique traditions. It is a very special place to many of us. **Did you know?** Ethiopia is one of the oldest countries in the world! It has never been ruled by another country. How amazing is that? Imagine you live in a big, beautiful house. You want to make sure your house and everyone in it is safe, right? Countries are a bit like that big house. They want to keep all their people safe.

Keeping Our Skies Safe!

Every country needs to feel safe. This means protecting its land and its people. Sometimes, countries need special tools to help them stay safe. This is like having a strong fence around your house or a brave guard dog! One important way to protect a country is to protect its skies. That means making sure nothing bad flies over. It's like having watchful eyes up in the clouds. **Did you know?** Birds are natural sky protectors! They fly very high and watch over everything below.

What Are Fighter Jets?

Let's talk about some cool tools! Imagine a super-fast airplane. Not an airplane that takes you on holiday, but one that is extra special. These are called fighter jets. They are like very quick birds that fly high in the sky. Their job is to keep a watchful eye. They fly around to make sure everything is okay up above. If there's any trouble, they are there to help protect. They are like the guardians of the sky! Fighter jets can fly incredibly fast. Faster than any car or train! They can zoom through the clouds. This helps them get to places quickly if they are needed for protection. **Did you know?** Some fighter jets can fly faster than the speed of sound! When they do, they make a "sonic boom" which sounds like a giant clap!

What Are Air Defence Systems?

Now, imagine another special tool. These are not flying in the sky. These tools stay on the ground. They are called air defence systems. They work together with the fighter jets. Think of them like very smart telescopes on the ground. They can see things far away in the sky. If something that isn't supposed to be there comes close, these systems help to keep it away. They are like a strong shield from the ground. So, fighter jets are in the sky, and air defence systems are on the ground. They are a team! They work together to make sure the country's sky is always safe and peaceful. **Did you know?** The first flying machines were kites, invented thousands of years ago! People always dreamed of flying.

Ethiopia Gets New Safety Tools!

Our friends in Ethiopia recently got some new and important safety tools. They got some of these amazing fighter jets. They also got some of those special air defence systems that stay on the ground. These new tools came from a country far away called Russia. Countries sometimes help each other. They share special tools or knowledge. It’s like when friends share their toys to play better together. Ethiopia wanted these new tools to help make its skies even safer. They want to protect their beautiful land and all the people living there. It's all about making sure everyone feels secure. **Did you know?** Russia is the largest country in the world! It is so big it crosses two continents.

Why Are New Tools Important?

Having these new sky protectors is very important for Ethiopia. It helps them be ready for anything. It shows they care deeply about keeping their country peaceful and their citizens happy. It's like getting a new, stronger lock for your door. It gives you more peace of mind. These jets and systems are there to make sure no one tries to cause trouble from the sky. They are meant to help maintain order. This means everyone can go to school, play, and live their lives without worrying. Safety is a very big deal for all of us. **Did you know?** Police cars and fire engines are also special safety tools! They help keep our communities safe every day.

A Place Called Tigray

Now, let's talk about a part of Ethiopia. It's a region called Tigray. Sometimes, in big countries, different groups of people or regions might have disagreements. Like when friends argue. In Tigray, there has been some "not getting along" for a while. It's like a big argument that needs to be sorted out. When there are arguments, sometimes people get sad or scared. These new fighter jets and air defence systems are meant to help bring more safety to places like Tigray. They are there to help protect the people and encourage everyone to find a peaceful way to live together. **Did you know?** Ethiopia has many different regions and many different languages spoken! It's a country with a rich mix of cultures.

Working Towards Peace

The biggest wish for everyone is peace. Peace means being happy, safe, and friendly with each other. It means no more arguments and everyone living together in harmony. These new safety tools are a step towards that. They are there to protect, not to cause more trouble. They help show that Ethiopia wants a strong and safe future for all its children and families. We all hope that the people in Tigray and all over Ethiopia can live in peace. We want happy faces and calm skies. It’s important to always choose kindness and understanding. **Did you know?** The symbol of peace is a dove, a beautiful white bird. It represents hope and new beginnings. So, little reporters, we learned a lot today! Ethiopia is working hard to keep its skies safe with new fighter jets and air defence systems. These tools help protect their country, especially in places like Tigray, where peace is so important. We wish Ethiopia and all its people much happiness and safety! Keep being curious and learning about our amazing world!
summary: Ethiopia has received new fighter jets and special ground systems from Russia to help keep its skies safe and bring peace to places like Tigray.
whyMatters: This is important because these new tools help Ethiopia protect its people and make sure everyone feels safe and can live happily, especially in places where there have been disagreements.

originalTitle: US convicts Rwandan man who hid genocide role for decades
title: A Sad Secret from Rwanda: The Story of Eric
content:
Hello, Young Friends! Your African News Reporter Here!

Hi everyone! It's me, your friendly news reporter for Africa! I'm here to tell you a story today. It's a story from a country called Rwanda. Rwanda is a beautiful country in Africa. It has green hills and amazing animals. But our story is about something sad that happened there a long, long time ago. It is important to learn about this so we can understand why kindness and truth are so important.

What is a "Genocide"? A Very Sad Time.

Many, many years ago, Rwanda went through a very sad time. This sad time is called a "genocide." **Did you know?** The word "genocide" means when a big group of people tries to hurt or kill another big group of people, just because they are different. It is a terrible, terrible thing. Imagine if someone didn't like you just because you had a different favorite color. And they wanted to hurt you for that. That's how sad and wrong a genocide is. It was a time when many innocent people in Rwanda lost their lives. It was a time of great sadness for many families. It was a time when people needed to be kind to each other, but some were not. This happened many, many years ago, long before most of you were born. But it's important to remember so we can learn to be kind and loving always. We must never let such a sad thing happen again. Rwanda has worked very hard to heal and become a strong, peaceful country.

A Man Named Eric and His Secret

Now, let's talk about a man named Eric. His full name is Eric Nshimiye. Eric was in Rwanda when the very sad genocide happened. He did some bad things during that time. He was part of the people who hurt others. But Eric didn't want anyone to know about the bad things he did. So, he kept a very big secret. He hid his role in the sad events for a very long time. He hoped nobody would ever find out about his past.

Hiding for Many, Many Years

How long did he hide his secret? He hid it for many, many years! We say "decades." **Did you know?** A "decade" means ten years. So "decades" means many tens of years! Imagine you are 2 years old, then 12, then 22, then 32, and even more! That's how long Eric kept his secret. He moved far away from Rwanda. He went to live in a country called America. He tried to start a new life there. He hoped nobody would ever find out about his past. He wanted to forget about the bad things he had done. But secrets can be very hard to keep forever.

The Truth Comes Out in America

Even though Eric lived far away, people in America found out about him. They found out he was not telling the truth. They found out about the bad things he did during the sad time in Rwanda. They started to ask him questions. They wanted to know the truth. Eric had to go to a special place called a court. In the court, grown-ups talk about what happened. They try to find out the truth.

What is a "Jury"?

In the court, there was a group of people called a "jury." **Did you know?** A jury is a group of normal grown-ups, like your aunts or uncles, who listen carefully to all sides of a story in court. They listen to everything. Then, they decide if someone did something wrong or not. They help the judge make a fair decision. Eric was asked questions by the jury. He was asked to tell his story. But Eric did not tell the truth to the jury. He lied to them. He lied to protect himself. He also lied to protect another person who had done bad things during the genocide.

Why Telling the Truth is Important

It is very, very important to always tell the truth. Even when it's hard. Even when you might be scared. Telling the truth helps everyone. Lying can make things even worse. Lying means you are not being honest. And honesty is a very good quality to have. Eric chose to lie to the jury. He thought he could keep his secret safe. But the jury listened carefully. They looked at all the information. They found out that Eric was not being truthful.

Eric is "Convicted"

After listening to everything, the jury made a decision. They decided that Eric was guilty. We say he was "convicted." **Did you know?** When someone is "convicted," it means the court has decided they definitely did the bad thing they were accused of. So, Eric was found guilty of lying. He was found guilty of trying to hide his past. He was found guilty of trying to protect another person who did bad things. This means he will face consequences for his actions. He will have to pay for what he did, both long ago and by lying in court. It shows that even after many, many years, the truth can still come out. And that hiding bad things does not make them go away.

Why This Matters for Rwanda

This news is important for the people of Rwanda. It shows that justice can happen. **Did you know?** "Justice" means making things fair and right, especially when bad things have happened. When people who did bad things are held responsible, it helps the country heal. It helps the families who lost loved ones. It helps everyone remember that good will always try to overcome bad. Rwanda is a country of hope now. Its people are working together to build a bright future. Remembering the past, and bringing justice, helps them do that. It reminds us all that every person is special and deserves kindness.

A Lesson for All of Us

So, my young friends, what can we learn from this story? We learn that telling the truth is super important. Always be honest, even when it's tough. We also learn that being kind to everyone is very, very important. No matter where they come from, or what they look like, or what they believe. Let's always choose kindness, understanding, and truth. Let's make our world a happy, peaceful place for everyone! Thank you for listening to our news today! See you next time!
summary: A man from Rwanda named Eric, who did bad things during a very sad time called the genocide many years ago, was found guilty in America for lying about his past and trying to protect another person.
whyMatters: This is important because it shows that telling the truth is always the right thing to do, and that justice can happen even after a very long time, helping people heal and reminding us all to be kind.

originalTitle: President Tinubu to 'pray for Nigeria' during Saudi Arabia trip
title: Our President's Special Trip to Pray for Nigeria!
content:
Hello, amazing friends and super bright kids across Africa! Your friendly news reporter is here with some very special news from our big country, Nigeria! Guess what? Our dear President, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, is going on a really important trip! He's travelling to a faraway land to do something very special for everyone in Nigeria. Let's find out all about it!

Who is President Tinubu?

President Tinubu is like the super-captain of our country, Nigeria! He's the person who helps make big decisions to keep everyone safe, happy, and healthy. Think of him like the head of a very big family – the family of Nigeria! He works hard every day to make sure our country grows stronger and better for all of us. He has a very important job, helping to make sure we have good schools, good roads, and good things for everyone to eat. He cares a lot about all the boys and girls, and every single person living in Nigeria. Did you know? A president is chosen by the people of a country! They vote to pick the person they believe will lead them best.

Where is He Going?

President Tinubu is going on a long aeroplane ride to a country called Saudi Arabia. It's very, very far away from Nigeria, across the big blue ocean and many lands! In Saudi Arabia, there is a super special and holy city called Mecca. It's a place where many, many people from all over the world, including lots of people from Nigeria, go to pray and feel close to God. It's a very important place for many people's faith. Think of it like going to a very special church, mosque, or temple that is famous around the whole world! People go there to share their hopes and wishes. Did you know? Saudi Arabia is famous for its very hot deserts and sometimes you can even see camels walking around there!

Why is He Going There?

This is the most important part! President Tinubu is going to Mecca in Saudi Arabia to pray for Nigeria. What does 'pray for Nigeria' mean? It means he will talk to God and ask for many good things for our beloved country. He will be asking for peace, happiness, and good luck for all the people of Nigeria. He wants everyone to live well, to have enough food, to have safe homes, and to be able to go to good schools. He will be thinking about every single person – every child like you, every mother, every father, every grandparent. He will wish for Nigeria to be a place where everyone can smile, play, and learn without worry. When you pray for someone, you are sending them lots of good thoughts and wishes from your heart, asking for blessings to come their way.

What Does 'Pray for Nigeria' Really Mean?

Imagine you want your best friend to do well in school, so you wish them good luck! Or you want your family to be healthy, so you think happy thoughts for them. That's a bit like what President Tinubu will be doing, but for a whole country! He will be asking for good weather for our farmers so they can grow yummy food. He will be asking for doctors and nurses to help people who are sick. He will be asking for teachers to be happy teaching children like you! It's a very kind and caring thing to do, showing that he holds Nigeria and all its people very close to his heart. It shows he is thinking about the future of our country. Did you know? Nigeria is known for its amazing music, delicious food like Jollof rice, and super friendly people! It's one of the biggest countries in Africa!

A Special Trip Before

This is not the first time President Tinubu has made a trip like this to Mecca. Do you remember when he was campaigning to become our President in 2022? That was before he was officially the President. Even then, he visited Mecca! He went there to pray for Nigeria and for a good future for the country, even when he was still hoping to become its leader. This shows he has always cared deeply about the well-being of Nigeria and its people. So, this trip is like a special tradition for him, showing his continuous hope and wishes for our nation.

Why is This Important for All of Us?

When our President takes the time to go on such a special journey just to pray for Nigeria, it's important for all of us because it shows he is thinking about *your* future! He is wishing for a safe, happy, and prosperous Nigeria for you to grow up in. It's like when your parents wish good things for you every day – it makes you feel loved and cared for. Our President is showing that same love and care for our whole country. His prayers are for a Nigeria where every child can go to school, where every family has a home, and where everyone can live together in peace and friendship. Did you know? When many people pray or wish for good things together, it can feel like a very powerful energy of hope and positivity!

Wishing Our President Well!

So, let's all wish our President Tinubu a safe journey to Saudi Arabia and back. Let's hope his prayers for Nigeria are heard and come true, bringing many blessings to our wonderful country and all its amazing people! We hope for a Nigeria filled with joy, peace, and lots of opportunities for every single one of you. Keep smiling, keep learning, and keep being the amazing kids you are! That's all for today's special news, friends!

originalTitle: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
title: Big Train News: All About Listening and Safety!
content:
Hello, amazing kids! It’s your friendly news reporter, Aisha, coming to you live from beautiful Africa! I love bringing you important stories from all over the world, and today we have a special one about trains. It’s a story that teaches us about listening carefully and staying super safe!

What Happened Far, Far Away?

Imagine a super-fast train, zooming along its tracks. Far away, in a country called Spain, there was a big accident involving trains. It was a very sad day because some people got hurt, and we always want everyone to be safe. It happened because of a mix-up, like when you tell your friend one thing, but they hear another.

How Do Trains Know Where to Go?

Trains are like giant metal snakes that run on special roads called tracks. They carry many people or lots of things from one place to another. Each train has a special driver, just like a bus or car driver. But trains are so big and fast, they need lots of help to stay safe! Did you know? The first trains were invented a long, long time ago, even before your great-grandparents were born! They used steam to move, like a giant tea kettle!

The Control Centre: Super Smart Helpers!

Think about your school. Your teachers help you know what to do, right? Trains have helpers too! There's a special place called a "control centre." It's full of big screens and lots of buttons. People work there to watch all the trains on the tracks. They talk to the train drivers using radios, just like walkie-talkies! They tell the drivers when to go, when to slow down, and when to stop. This helps keep everyone safe and on time. It's a very important job!

A Mix-Up on the Tracks

Now, here’s where the important lesson comes in. The people at the control centre need to talk very, very clearly to the train drivers. And the drivers need to listen very, very carefully. In this sad story from Spain, something went wrong. A big recording, like a voice message, showed what happened. It looked like one very fast train had stopped up ahead. We call it "stalled" when a train or car stops and can't move, maybe because of a problem, like when your toy car runs out of batteries!

Telling Trains to Go

But then, something confusing happened. Another train, also big and fast, was told it was okay to move. We call this "given clearance." It means someone said, "Yes, you can go!" Imagine if you were told to run, but there was a big toy in your way that someone forgot to tell you about! So, one train was stopped, and another train was told it was safe to go, even though the first train was still there. This was a big mistake. Did you know? High-speed trains can go super, super fast, sometimes faster than a cheetah running! That's why it's so important for them to be careful.

Learning From Mistakes

When something like this happens, it makes everyone sad. But it also teaches us a very important lesson. We need to find out exactly what went wrong so it never happens again. People are looking at all the information, like listening to those recordings, to understand everything. It's like when you make a mistake in your homework; your teacher helps you understand so you can do better next time.

Who Helps When Things Go Wrong?

When there’s an accident, lots of brave helpers rush to the scene. Firefighters, doctors, and nurses, and many other kind people come to help anyone who is hurt. They are like real-life superheroes! It’s important to remember that even when sad things happen, there are always good people ready to help. Did you know? Many trains in Africa help carry yummy food and important goods from one city to another, making sure everyone has what they need!

Always Listen and Be Safe!

This story reminds us how important it is to listen. Whether it's your parents telling you not to run near the road, or your teacher explaining a game, listening carefully keeps you safe. And it’s the same for big train drivers and people in control centres. Clear talking and careful listening are super important for everyone.

Staying Safe Around Trains

Even though this happened far away, we can all learn from it. Here are some simple rules for you: * Never play on or near train tracks. Tracks are only for trains! * Always wait for trains to pass completely before crossing, even if you think it's far away. * Listen for train horns and bells. They are telling you to be careful! * If you see something strange on the tracks, tell a grown-up right away.

Our Promise for a Safer World!

Even though this was a sad story, it helps us learn. We want to live in a world where everyone is safe, and we can all help make that happen by being careful, listening, and looking out for each other. Thank you for listening, kids! This is Aisha, your reporter, wishing you a super safe and happy day!
summary: A news story from Spain about a train accident teaches us how important it is for train drivers and control centres to talk and listen very carefully to keep everyone safe.
whyMatters: This story is important because it shows us that clear talking and careful listening are super important for safety, not just for trains but for everyone, everywhere.

originalTitle: 'Fully committed' Fernandes to remain Man Utd captain
title: Bruno is Still Captain! Hooray for Football!
content:
Hello, amazing friends in Africa! It's your kid-friendly news reporter here, ready with some super exciting news from the big world of football! Do you love kicking a ball around with your friends? Do you cheer for your favourite teams? Well, get ready to smile, because we have news about a very special football player and his team!

Meet Our Football Hero!

Imagine a player who runs fast, passes the ball perfectly, and scores amazing goals! That player is Bruno Fernandes. He is a famous football player. Bruno comes all the way from a country called Portugal. He plays for a very, very big team. This team is called Manchester United. It is a famous team from England.

What is a Captain?

Every team needs a leader, right? In football, that leader is called the captain. Think of the captain like the head boy or head girl in your school. Or maybe like the oldest brother or sister who helps everyone. The captain wears a special band on their arm. It shows everyone they are the leader. The captain helps their teammates. They talk to the coach. They make sure everyone plays fair. They try to inspire their team to do their very best. It’s a very important job! They need to be brave and kind. They need to be good at playing too.

Why Bruno is a Great Captain

Bruno Fernandes is a wonderful captain. He works very, very hard in every game. He never gives up, even when things are tough. He encourages his teammates. He claps for them. He helps them when they make a mistake. He loves to score goals for his team. This makes the fans very happy! He also talks to the referee sometimes. He does this to help his team. He is a very smart player. He thinks about the game all the time. He wants his team to win always. That is what a great captain does!

Did You Know? Fun Football Facts!

Did you know that football is the most popular sport in the whole wide world? So many people play it! So many people watch it! Maybe you play football too! Did you know that Manchester United is one of the biggest football clubs? They have fans all over the world. Yes, even right here in Africa! Many kids in Africa dream of playing for a team like Manchester United one day. Did you know that a football match lasts for 90 minutes? That's a long time! But it's split into two halves, with a small break in the middle. Players run a lot during this time! Did you know that the captain's armband is often a different colour? It helps everyone see who the captain is easily. It is like a badge of honour.

Manchester United: A Super Team!

Manchester United is a very old and famous football team. They play in beautiful red shirts. Their home stadium is called Old Trafford. It is a giant place where thousands of fans cheer very loudly! The team has won many, many trophies. A trophy is like a big shiny cup you get for winning. Many famous players have played for Manchester United. They are known for playing exciting football. They have fans from all countries. They have a special song too that their fans sing. It makes the stadium feel alive!

Coach Says "Yes, Bruno!"

Now for the big news! The coach of Manchester United is like the main teacher for the team. His name is Michael Carrick. He is a very important person. The coach decides who plays and who is the captain. Well, guess what? Coach Michael Carrick said that Bruno Fernandes will continue to be the captain! Yes, he will still wear the special armband. He will still lead the team. This is super news because it means the coach trusts Bruno very much. It means Bruno is doing a fantastic job. It shows that Coach Carrick believes in Bruno. He believes Bruno is the best person to lead the team on the field. He knows Bruno will always try his best. This makes the team strong.

Why This News is Super Good!

When a captain stays, it means the team feels strong and steady. It means everyone knows who their leader is. This helps the players feel safe and confident. It helps them play better together. It shows everyone that Bruno is a very important part of the team. Imagine if your class had a new head boy or girl every week! It might be confusing, right? It's much better when a good leader stays. It helps everyone work together nicely. It helps the team understand each other. This is why it is good that Bruno is still the captain. He helps the new players feel welcome. He sets a good example for everyone. He shows them how to work hard and how to play with a happy heart. This is what makes a team successful.

Football in Africa: We Love It Too!

We know how much you amazing kids in Africa love football! You play it in your schools, in your streets, and in your fields. You dream of being a football star just like Bruno Fernandes. This news shows that hard work and being a good leader can take you far. Maybe one day, one of you will be the captain of a big team! Or maybe you will be a great leader in your home or village. Football teaches us about teamwork, following rules, and never giving up. These are important lessons for life, not just for the game.

You Can Be a Leader Too!

Bruno Fernandes is a leader on the football field. But you can be a leader too! You can be a leader in your home by helping your parents. You can be a leader in your school by helping your friends. You can be a leader by being kind and sharing your toys. Every little act of leadership makes a difference. Remember, a leader is someone who helps others, who is brave, and who tries their best. Just like Bruno Fernandes does for Manchester United!

Let's Keep Cheering!

So, next time you see Manchester United playing, remember Bruno Fernandes. Remember he is their captain, leading them with a big heart and a lot of skill. Let's keep cheering for him and for all the amazing footballers! Hooray for football and hooray for Bruno!
summary: Manchester United's coach said that Bruno Fernandes will stay as the team's captain, which is great news for the football club and its many fans.
whyMatters: This is important because Bruno is a strong leader for the team. When a good captain stays, it helps everyone work together well, makes the team stronger, and helps them play their best to win games.

title: Mourinho and chaos - is Real Madrid boss misunderstood?
content: Jose Mourinho has spent the past decade seeing other managers hailed as geniuses, but did Real Madrid's win at Barcelona show he's been misunderstood?
